node.statement: Unit-norm step. Let C_N,e_N be witnesses from lem-compcb-compressed-unit-norm. Each P_n is a delta-projection and ||P_n||=||P||, so the nonvanishing alternative for P passes to P_n. Applying the external to P_n gives abs(||u_{P,n}||-1)<=C_N*e whenever e<=e_N, uniformly in n.
